notes.title: Sakura Alien 3 - Release
notes.notes:
https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/8132109/f500ee90dd51fdfc1137c356a294d2a121fe0da7.png
When Haru discovers that his friend, Hiyori, was hiding a huge secret, he’s forced to say goodbye to her. Haru misses Hiyori, however, and he’s determined to see her again – even if he has to travel into the furthest recesses of space to do it. In doing so, Ena and Haru tumble into surprising complications, hindering the pair to fully enjoy their trip to visit Hiyori.

Find out what those entail in Sakura Alien 3: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3022500/Sakura_Alien_3/

Missed out on the previous story? 
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/28070/Sakura_Alien_Bundle/

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/5189/Winged_Cloud_Bundle/
